facts.fact: 坠落告白：你在怀我无所惧
facts.anchor: “As long as I have you in my arms, I fear nothing.”

facts.fact: 墓室里她轻声说记得你们
facts.anchor: “I see you,” she whispered. “And I remember you.”

facts.fact: 半和解：至少今天我理解你
